period_note: Sourced directly from the bank's own primary half-yearly interim financial statements ("Half Yearly Financial Statements as on 30 June 2021 (Unaudited)"), used as the Q2 data point. Per project convention the SOLO ('Balance Sheet as at 30 June 2021 (Unaudited)' / 'Profit and Loss Account for the Half Year ended 30 June 2021') figures are used, not 'Consolidated'. Arithmetically verified: Total liabilities 385,062.93m + Total equity 29,030.10m = Total assets 414,093.03m exactly; every P&L subtotal from Total operating income (10,539.72m) down to Net profit after tax (1,851.04m) reconciles exactly. NAV per share is printed directly on the face of the Solo Balance Sheet (27.20) and confirmed by Note 3.c.1. This filing also discloses (Note 2) a BSEC-mandated deviation-explanation table: interest income fell YoY due to the imposed 9% lending-rate cap and a loan-moratorium stimulus package, while deposit costs also fell as rates were repriced down. Non Funded Income is calculated as Commission/exchange/brokerage + Other operating income (both individually reported). 2021 Q1 and Q3 could not be recovered: neither is present in the bank's own financial-statements archive (legacy.citybankplc.com) nor found on Wayback Machine; recorded as genuine gaps.
